fullPassage: The History of the Kings of Britain laid the groundwork that future Arthurian writers, such as Marie de France and Sir Thomas Malory, would build upon, with Monmouth defining King Arthur's personality and family history, as well as his strong ties to Merlin. Still, eventually, The History began to fall out of favour, as scholars started to realize how much of a massive jump in logic needed to be taken to read the whole book at face value. In 1718, one Aaron Thompson published the first English translation of The History and was so worried that by reprinting Monmouth's writing he'd be opening a Pandora's box of misinformation that he included a large tome of an introduction, going to great pains to remind the reader that The History is: 'barbarous and in many places unclear'. We'll likely never know why Geoffrey of Monmouth included so much fabrication in his history of Britain. Still, it's perhaps one of history's most impressive lies and still impacts our lives today. The debate on whether King Arthur was real rages on, though with little concrete evidence that he was. Interestingly though, there are accounts of a ninth-century warlord and tenth-century Welsh leader with that name, which is possibly where Monmouth got the inspiration for his fictional version. Slightly redundant historic arguments aside, the cultural legacy of The History is almost as unbelievable as its source material, spanning two Shakespeare plays, as well as countless books, films, and TV shows that have built on the Arthurian legend. Geoffrey of Monmouth may still be seen by many to be a pseudo-historian, but his lies make him perhaps one of the greatest fiction writers of all time.

det.korean: 그의 거짓말은 그를 아마도 역대 최고의 소설 작가 중 한 명으로 만들어 준다.
det.analysis: ✅ his lies make him perhaps one of the greatest fiction writers of all time: 주어(his lies)+동사(make)+목적어(him)+목적격보어(one of the greatest fiction writers of all time) 구조의 5형식 문장이다. ❌ make와 him의 순서가 바뀌거나 one of the+최상급+복수명사 구조가 깨지면 어법상 성립하지 않는다.
det.tip: 'make+목적어+목적격보어' 5형식 구문과 'one of the+최상급+복수명사'(최고 중 하나) 구문을 함께 기억한다.

questions.passage: The History of the Kings of Britain laid the groundwork that future Arthurian writers, such as Marie de France and Sir Thomas Malory, would build upon, with Monmouth __________ King Arthur's personality and family history, as well as his strong ties to Merlin. Still, eventually, The History began to fall out of favour, as scholars started to realize how much of a massive jump in logic needed to be taken to read the whole book at face value.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 주어진 단어를 문맥과 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓸 것) (define)

det.korean: 몬머스가 아서왕의 성격과 가족사를 '정의하면서'라는 의미로, 'with+명사+분사' 구문에서 몬머스가 능동적으로 정의하는 주체이므로 현재분사 defining으로 써야 한다.
det.analysis: ✅ defining: with Monmouth defining ~는 '몬머스가 ~을 정의하면서'라는 동시상황을 나타내는 분사구문이며, Monmouth가 정의하는 주체(능동)이므로 현재분사가 되어야 한다. ❌ define(원형)이나 defined(과거분사)는 각각 동사 원형 또는 수동의 의미가 되어 구문이 성립하지 않는다.
det.tip: 'with+명사+분사' 구문에서 명사가 분사 행위의 주체이면 현재분사(-ing), 대상이면 과거분사(p.p.)를 쓴다.

questions.passage: Interestingly though, there are accounts of a ninth-century warlord and tenth-century Welsh leader with that name, which is possibly where Monmouth got the inspiration for his fictional version. Slightly redundant historic arguments aside, the cultural legacy of The History is almost as unbelievable as its source material, __________ two Shakespeare plays, as well as countless books, films, and TV shows that have built on the Arthurian legend.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 주어진 단어를 문맥과 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓸 것) (span)

det.korean: 문화적 유산이 셰익스피어 희곡 두 편에 '걸쳐 있다'는 의미로, 앞의 주절을 부가적으로 설명하는 분사구문이므로 현재분사 spanning으로 써야 한다.
det.analysis: ✅ spanning: 주절 전체를 의미상 주어로 하여 '~에 걸쳐 있으면서'라는 동시상황을 나타내는 분사구문으로, 능동의 의미이므로 현재분사가 되어야 한다. ❌ span(원형)이나 spanned(과거분사)는 각각 동사 원형 또는 수동의 의미가 되어 문장 구조가 성립하지 않는다.
det.tip: 분사구문은 주절의 주어와 분사의 관계가 능동이면 -ing, 수동이면 p.p.로 쓴다는 원칙을 적용한다.
